# Evolving Cache Schedules for Fast Diffusion Policy Inference ### Training-Free Global Cache Scheduling via Evolutionary Search --- ## Overview Evolving Cache Schedules (EVO) accelerates transformer-based Diffusion Policy by offline-optimizing a global cache schedule over the block–timestep lattice with an evolutionary algorithm and reusing residual caches during iterative denoising. With redundancy-aware initialization and target-conditioned early stopping, EVO targets the closed-loop action generation bottleneck where uniform computation allocation fails to exploit heterogeneous redundancy across transformer blocks and denoising steps. --- ## Overview Evolving Cache Schedules (EVO) accelerates transformer-based Diffusion Policy by offline-optimizing a global cache schedule over the block–timestep lattice with an evolutionary algorithm and reusing residual caches during iterative denoising. EVO targets the closed-loop action generation bottleneck in visuomotor control, where uniform computation allocation fails to exploit heterogeneous redundancy across transformer blocks and denoising steps. --- ## Key Features - **Global Cache Scheduling:** Offline-optimized cache schedule that allocates refresh positions over the full block–timestep lattice under a fixed computation budget. - **Rollout-driven Evolutionary Search:** Evolutionary search framework that optimizes complete cache schedules using closed-loop rollout performance as the fitness. - **Practical Search Mechanisms:** Redundancy-aware initialization and target-conditioned early stopping that reduce the cost of rollout-based schedule search. - **Plug-and-Play Acceleration:** Wraps pretrained Diffusion Policy checkpoints without updating policy parameters, modifying the diffusion sampler, or changing the action interface. --- ## Installation If the repository has already been cloned without submodules, initialize Diffusion Policy with: This implementation targets transformer-based Diffusion Policy checkpoints.

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出EVO，通过进化算法离线优化全局缓存调度（在块-时间步格点上分配刷新位置），结合冗余感知初始化与目标条件早期停止，实现训练-free的缓存复用加速。


# 一、动机

> Transformer-based Diffusion Policy在闭合环路动作生成中，均匀计算分配无法利用不同Transformer块和去噪步骤的异构冗余，导致推理效率低。现有缓存调度方法仅针对单步或局部优化，缺乏全局最优的缓存策略。


# 二、方法

> 提出EVO，通过进化算法离线优化全局缓存调度（在块-时间步格点上分配刷新位置），结合冗余感知初始化与目标条件早期停止，实现训练-free的缓存复用加速。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在仿真机器人控制任务中，EVO在保持动作质量的同时，将Diffusion Policy推理速度提升约2倍，且无需修改模型参数或采样器（具体数字未在摘要中给出，需参考论文正文）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与课题不相关（本笔记主要面向具身智能中的运动控制与缓存优化，与机器人任务相关，但属于方法加速，可关注）。
